breaking.change: Custom PCM sound authoring now uses checked TS content declarations decoded directly into the native sound encoder. The sound OGT generate parser and SoundSource interface are deleted. Automatic sound chunks are actual outputs in the content reference graph; raw audio import and the separate sfx domain are unchanged.
breaking.fix: Export file.sound({rate, channels, samples}) from content/<name>.ts using @origingame/engine/author. Load <module>/<content-relative-stem> with og.load.sound instead of an .ogt path. Float32Array and ordinary arrays are accepted; give complete interleaved frames. See og api show file:sound. Do not write a generate block or import SoundSource from engine/generate.
